          Help Me Choose

          FAQs for More Rewards RBC Visa Infinite Credit Card

          The More Rewards RBC Visa Infinite credit card is available to residents of all provinces except Quebec. More Reward partner locations are situated in Western Canada (British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, Yukon, Saskatchewan). More Rewards partner locations can be found at morerewards.ca/earn/partners and are subject to change from time to time without notice.

          You can earn and redeem points at all participating More Rewards partner locations, including Save-On-Foods, Quality Foods, Buy-Low Foods, PriceSmart Foods, Urban Fare, Nesters Market, and Pure Pharmacy. A list of current More Rewards partner locations can be found at morerewards.ca/earn/partners and are subject to change from time to time without notice.

          You can also redeem points online for other valuable rewards like travel, events, gift cards, donations and more. To view a full list of redemption partners, please visit morerewards.ca/rewards.

          No. You do not need to swipe both your More Rewards card and More Rewards RBC Visa Infinite credit card to receive 8 points per dollar at participating More Rewards locations. However, by swiping your More Rewards loyalty card, you will earn an additional More Rewards point for every dollar spent at participating More Rewards locations, plus you will be eligible to receive any additional points promotions available at that time.

          Please have your More Rewards loyalty card number and AC number handy to link your existing More Rewards loyalty account to your More Rewards RBC Visa Infinite credit card while completing your credit card application. To link your More Rewards account successfully, ensure both your More Rewards member profile and More Rewards RBC Visa Infinite credit card application have matching details.

          Your More Rewards loyalty card number is located on the back of your physical More Rewards loyalty card directly under the barcode or under the barcode of your digital card. The More Rewards loyalty card number is 11-digits or 12-digits and begins with 48. Only More Rewards cards that start with 48 are eligible to be linked to your More Rewards RBC Visa Infinite credit card. To get a new More Rewards card please sign up at https://www.morerewards.ca/enroll.

          You can also find your More Rewards loyalty card number by logging into your More Rewards account at account.morerewards.ca.

          Your AC number is located on the back of your physical More Rewards loyalty card, directly under your card number or on the right side of your digital card, across from your name. You can also find your AC number by logging into your More Rewards online profile. If you can’t find your AC number, please contact More Rewards here.

          Yes. Please contact us at 1-800-769-2512 to update your More Rewards card number. To link your More Rewards loyalty account successfully, ensure both your More Rewards member profile and More Rewards RBC Visa Infinite credit card application have matching details. If you need to verify or update your More Rewards member profile details please visit account.morerewards.ca or call More Rewards customer service at 1-833-690-1146.

          Your More Rewards points are added to your More Rewards loyalty account monthly after your credit card statement date.

          The welcome More Rewards points will appear on your monthly credit card statement and your More Rewards loyalty account up to six (6) weeks after your first purchase, provided your More Rewards RBC Visa Infinite credit card account (“credit card Account”) remains open and in good standing at that time, “good standing” meaning that your credit card Account must not be past due for more than two (2) consecutive credit card Account statement periods, closed, charged off or in credit revoked status at that time.
